items.en: OIC condemns attack on Syrian Internal Security Forces bus near Damascus, causing injuries.

items.en: Settlers burn room and vehicle south of Nablus.
items.he: מתנחלים שרפו חדר ורכב מדרום לשכם.

items.en: Palestinian sources report 592 Israeli settlements and outposts, with "Israel" controlling 42% of West Bank.
